roi_selection: Three tissue locations fixed from overview before inference; no outcome-based ROI selection.
preprocessing: Native level 0 RGB, uint8 / 255 in existing predict(); no resize or stain normalization.
timing_scope: warm CPU predict(): patch RGB extraction + tissue gate + forward + probability stitch + components + NMS; excludes OpenSlide reading, model load, hashing, PNG/JSON writing and difference selection
memory_scope: fresh process per ROI/method; absolute process high-water RSS including Python/runtime imports, OpenSlide open/read/cache, model load, one warmup and three timed predictions; sampled before result serialization
case_selection: 64x64 windows centered on one internal 128px seam, with the other center coordinate sampled every 16px; changed pixels >=16 and boundary changes >0; rank boundary-changed descending, total changed descending, then y/x ascending; at most one per ROI.
